title: Chapter 231: I Forgot I Have on Make-up
html:
The three visitors were thoroughly entangled. Chen Ge had never encountered anything like it in his Haunted House. “Call emergency services? There’s no need. I’ll help you myself.”

Planting one foot against Song An’s back, he seized Xiao Du’s arm. “Brace yourself!”

He leaned backward and hauled Xiao Du free.

“Ow! Ow!”

After a lengthy struggle, he finally separated them. Looking down at the three pale visitors sprawled across the floor, he could not help sighing. “My recent visitors really haven’t been in good physical condition.”

Dressed as a doctor and holding a hammer, Chen Ge received no response. For the visitors, this day would remain etched in their hearts forever—a ‘precious’ memory they could never forget.

“Can you walk? I’ll lead you out.” Chen Ge retrieved the female mannequin’s head and placed it beside her body, then helped the visitors leave through the director’s office.

Outside the Haunted House, the crowd had divided into two groups. Ordinary visitors sat beneath the rest tent, eagerly watching the commotion, while Tian Teng Medical School’s fans waited anxiously for the result.

“Manager Xu, it has been almost forty minutes, why aren’t they out yet?”

“They’ve called for help! Manager, are you sure nothing has gone wrong?”

Uncle Xu stood outside the Haunted House selling tickets, surrounded by four young men and women. Had Chen Ge been there, he would have recognized them as the other employees of Tian Teng Medical School.

“I... I’m sure they’re fine.” Sweat covered Uncle Xu, though in truth, he had no idea. A normal tour lasted twenty minutes, and whenever visitors exceeded that time, trouble was bound to follow.

“You’ve wiped your forehead at least ten times in two minutes. Boss, you’re making us nervous!” The speaker’s surname was Lin. He had played the corpse hidden beneath the baby’s crib. Without makeup, he looked even paler.

“Don’t worry.” Despite his words, Uncle Xu was more anxious than any of them. During Fei Youliang’s visit, the man had emerged eight minutes late and gone straight to the hospital. This time, the delay had reached twenty minutes. This was bad.

Uncle Xu did not dare consider the possible reasons. In fact, he had summoned the park’s medical team ten minutes earlier; stretchers already waited beneath the rest tent.

“Let’s wait a little longer. Perhaps they’re having too much fun.”

Another minute passed before the curtain finally flew open. A striking woman stumbled out, her face colorless and her short hair plastered to her cheeks and forehead. The moment she reached the light, she crumpled to the ground, chest heaving as though she had just finished a marathon.

“Someone is out!”

“It’s Ye Xiaoxin!”

“Isn’t she the country’s foremost Haunted House reviewer? How did she end up like this?”

“This proves that you cannot believe everything on the internet. After all, she wasn’t a professional from Tian Teng Medical School, so it’s understandable that she is this scared.”

When Ye Xiaoxin made it out, Uncle Xu breathed a sigh of relief. Thank God!

He had just opened the gate to help her when the curtain parted a second time.

Guo Miao looked years older. He collided with the wall before staggering through the entrance, his eyes lifeless. Spotting Ye Xiaoxin on the left, he instinctively collapsed to the right. He knelt beneath the sun and doubled over as if about to vomit.

“Boss!”

The other Tian Teng Medical School employees rushed forward. Their boss’s distress left them too shocked for words, and the fans outside the Haunted House were equally speechless.

“It was only a Haunted House tour, wasn’t it? Why does he look as if he just survived a roller coaster?”

Soon afterward, the heavy curtain opened again. Song An limped out first, followed by Chen Ge supporting the other two visitors. Because he had not removed his mask, his appearance drew screams from the crowd. Even Uncle Xu recoiled. A coward by nature, he had never entered Chen Ge’s Haunted House.

“Nothing serious. They were only frightened.” Chen Ge set Xiao Du and Su Luoluo down by the entrance, then noticed the other Tian Teng Medical School employees. Before they could question him, he said, “You came to support Tian Teng Medical School, correct? Don’t worry. In ten minutes, I can arrange a tour for you too.”

The words that they wanted to say were stuck in their throats.

“If there’s nothing else, I’m going back. There’s still one visitor I haven’t found.”

The Tian Teng Medical School employees exchanged glances. They worked in the same business and understood that unexpected incidents occurred, but what exactly had Chen Ge meant by that last sentence?

Back inside the Haunted House, Chen Ge reviewed the Third Sick Hall’s surveillance footage. It showed Han Qiuming struggling amid a sea of mannequins before being dragged into a sickroom.

Chen Ge returned to the Third Sick Hall to retrieve him. Behind the wooden door, he found Han Qiuming unconscious on the floor, his glasses hanging crookedly from his face and mannequin parts scattered all around him.

“You guys even helped him find his glasses. Nice job, very polite.”

Chen Ge held a finger beneath Han Qiuming’s nose and felt him breathing. He appeared physically unharmed. Whether he would leave with scars that made him scream in a hospital bed at midnight, as Fei Youliang had, was another question.

Gripping Han Qiuming by the arms, Chen Ge dragged him toward the door. The movement roused the man, and his eyes slowly opened. At the sight of a blood-covered doctor dragging him away, Han Qiuming instinctively struggled. From his perspective, Chen Ge was not rescuing him but hauling him off to be butchered.

“Don’t move. I’m here to help,” Chen Ge told him kindly. But Han Qiuming’s consciousness was fraying; he could not understand and merely muttered, “Ghost... ghost...”

“What ghost? Are you hallucinating?” Chen Ge did not know what had happened. According to his design, even triggering every trap should not have reduced Han Qiuming to this state.

“How are you a Haunted House designer if you’re so easily scared?” Chen Ge released the man, and Han Qiuming pulled on the mattress on the floor and tried to crawl toward the corner.

“What are you so afraid of? I’m taking you outside. I work here.”

Han Qiuming still would not listen. Left with no alternative, Chen Ge gripped his shoulders and removed the skin mask. “Look at me. I’m the owner of this Haunted House.”

Forced to look up, Han Qiuming saw a lifeless face beneath the skin mask.

“Dead, dead, dead people…”

As Han Qiuming fainted once more, Chen Ge touched his face and suddenly remembered that he had applied the corpse makeup before putting on the skin mask.
